newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom chairman sees share listing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom chairman sees share listing in 1997.

text.p: France Telecom Chairman Michel Bon said in a newspaper interview on Monday that he expected the state-owned telecommunications group to list shares on the Paris bourse in mid-April 1997.
"If market conditions are favourable, we're planning to open up the capital in the second half of April 1997... It will take the classic form of a public share offering," he told Les Echos newspaper.

Even at the low end of the valuation range for the telecom operator -- valued at between 100 billion and 200 billion francs ($19.6 billion to $39.2 billion) -- the market would not be able to absorb 49 percent in one go and share sales would have to be carried out in two stages, he said.
Bon said he expected France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom to take cross-holdings once their shares were listed. "We could then pursue our plans for cross-shareholdings," he said.
